verses.original: פַּלְגֵי־ מַ֣יִם לֶב־ מֶ֭לֶךְ בְּיַד־ יְהוָ֑ה עַֽל־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֖ר יַחְפֹּ֣ץ יַטֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: pal·ḡê- ma·yim leḇ- me·leḵ bə·yaḏ- Yah·weh ‘al- kāl- ’ă·šer yaḥ·pōṣ yaṭ·ṭen·nū
verses.literal: The king’s heart is a waterway . . . in the hand of the LORD He directs it where . . . He pleases
verses.literalPt: COMO ribeiros de águas assim é o coração do rei na mão do SENHOR, que o inclina a todo o seu querer.

verses.original: כָּֽל־ דֶּרֶךְ־ אִ֭ישׁ יָשָׁ֣ר בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְתֹכֵ֖ן לִבּ֣וֹת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- de·reḵ- ’îš yā·šār bə·‘ê·nāw wə·ṯō·ḵên lib·bō·wṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: All a man’s ways seem right to him but the LORD weighs the heart
verses.literalPt: Todo caminho do homem é reto aos seus olhos, mas o SENHOR sonda os corações.

verses.original: עֲ֭שֹׂה צְדָקָ֣ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט נִבְחָ֖ר לַיהוָ֣ה מִזָּֽבַח׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·śōh ṣə·ḏā·qāh ū·miš·pāṭ niḇ·ḥār Yah·weh miz·zā·ḇaḥ
verses.literal: To do righteousness and justice is more desirable to the LORD than sacrifice
verses.literalPt: Fazer justiça e juízo é mais aceitável ao SENHOR do que sacrifício.

verses.original: רוּם־ עֵ֭ינַיִם וּרְחַב־ לֵ֑ב נִ֖ר רְשָׁעִ֣ים חַטָּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: rūm- ‘ê·na·yim ū·rə·ḥaḇ- lêḇ nir rə·šā·‘îm ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ
verses.literal: Haughty eyes and a proud heart the guides of the wicked are sin
verses.literalPt: Os olhos altivos, o coração orgulhoso e a lavoura dos ímpios é pecado.

verses.original: מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת חָ֭רוּץ אַךְ־ לְמוֹתָ֑ר וְכָל־ אָ֝֗ץ אַךְ־ לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: maḥ·šə·ḇō·wṯ ḥā·rūṣ ’aḵ- lə·mō·w·ṯār wə·ḵāl ’āṣ ’aḵ- lə·maḥ·sō·wr
verses.literal: The plans of the diligent bring plenty as surely as haste leads to poverty
verses.literalPt: Os pensamentos do diligente tendem só para a abundância, porém os de todo apressado, tão-somente para a pobreza.

verses.original: פֹּ֣עַל א֭וֹצָרוֹת בִּלְשׁ֣וֹן שָׁ֑קֶר הֶ֥בֶל נִ֝דָּ֗ף מְבַקְשֵׁי־ מָֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: pō·‘al ’ō·w·ṣā·rō·wṯ bil·šō·wn šā·qer he·ḇel nid·dāp̄ mə·ḇaq·šê- mā·weṯ
verses.literal: Making a fortune by a lying tongue is a vanishing mist a deadly pursuit
verses.literalPt: Trabalhar com língua falsa para ajuntar tesouros é vaidade que conduz aqueles que buscam a morte.

verses.original: שֹׁד־ רְשָׁעִ֥ים יְגוֹרֵ֑ם כִּ֥י מֵ֝אֲנ֗וּ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: šōḏ- rə·šā·‘îm yə·ḡō·w·rêm kî mê·’ă·nū la·‘ă·śō·wṯ miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: The violence of the wicked will sweep them away because they refuse to do what is just
verses.literalPt: As rapinas dos ímpios os destruirão, porquanto se recusam a fazer justiça.

verses.original: הֲפַכְפַּ֬ךְ דֶּ֣רֶךְ אִ֣ישׁ וָזָ֑ר וְ֝זַ֗ךְ יָשָׁ֥ר פָּעֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·p̄aḵ·paḵ de·reḵ ’îš wā·zār wə·zaḵ yā·šār pā·‘o·lōw
verses.literal: The way of a guilty man is crooked but the conduct of the innocent is upright
verses.literalPt: O caminho do homem é todo perverso e estranho, porém a obra do homem puro é reta.

verses.original: ט֗וֹב לָשֶׁ֥בֶת עַל־ פִּנַּת־ גָּ֑ג מֵאֵ֥שֶׁת מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים וּבֵ֥ית חָֽבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ lā·še·ḇeṯ ‘al- pin·naṯ- gāḡ mê·’ê·šeṯ miḏ·yā·nîm ū·ḇêṯ ḥā·ḇer
verses.literal: Better to live on a corner of the roof than to share a house with a quarrelsome wife
verses.literalPt: É melhor morar num canto de telhado do que ter como companheira em casa ampla uma mulher briguenta.

verses.original: נֶ֣פֶשׁ רָ֭שָׁע אִוְּתָה־ רָ֑ע לֹא־ יֻחַ֖ן בְּעֵינָ֣יו רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ne·p̄eš rā·šā‘ ’iw·wə·ṯāh- rā‘ lō- yu·ḥan bə·‘ê·nāw rê·‘ê·hū
verses.literal: The soul of the wicked man craves evil his neighbor finds no favor . . . in his eyes
verses.literalPt: A alma do ímpio deseja o mal; o seu próximo não agrada aos seus olhos.

verses.original: בַּעְנָשׁ־ לֵ֭ץ יֶחְכַּם־ פֶּ֑תִי וּבְהַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְ֝חָכָ֗ם יִקַּח־ דָּֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: ba‘·nāš- lēṣ yeḥ·kam- pe·ṯî ū·ḇə·haś·kîl lə·ḥā·ḵām yiq·qaḥ- dā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: When a mocker is punished the simple gain wisdom and when a wise man is instructed he acquires knowledge
verses.literalPt: Quando o escarnecedor é castigado, o simples torna-se sábio; e o sábio quando é instruído recebe o conhecimento.

verses.original: מַשְׂכִּ֣יל צַ֭דִּיק לְבֵ֣ית רָשָׁ֑ע מְסַלֵּ֖ף רְשָׁעִ֣ים לָרָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: maś·kîl ṣad·dîq lə·ḇêṯ rā·šā‘ mə·sal·lêp̄ rə·šā·‘îm lā·rā‘
verses.literal: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked and brings the wicked to ruin
verses.literalPt: O justo considera com prudência a casa do ímpio; mas Deus destrói os ímpios por causa dos seus males.

verses.original: אֹטֵ֣ם אָ֭זְנוֹ מִזַּעֲקַת־ דָּ֑ל גַּֽם־ ה֥וּא יִ֝קְרָ֗א וְלֹ֣א יֵעָנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·ṭêm ’ā·zə·nōw miz·za·‘ă·qaṯ- dāl gam- hū yiq·rā wə·lō yê·‘ā·neh
verses.literal: Whoever shuts his ears to the cry of the poor he too shall cry out and receive no answer
verses.literalPt: O que tapa o seu ouvido ao clamor do pobre, ele mesmo também clamará e não será ouvido.

verses.original: מַתָּ֣ן בַּ֭סֵּתֶר יִכְפֶּה־ אָ֑ף וְשֹׁ֥חַד בַּ֝חֵ֗ק חֵמָ֥ה עַזָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mat·tān bas·sê·ṯer yiḵ·peh- ’āp̄ wə·šō·ḥaḏ ba·ḥêq ḥê·māh ‘az·zāh
verses.literal: A gift in secret soothes anger and a covert bribe pacifies great wrath
verses.literalPt: O presente dado em segredo aplaca a ira, e a dádiva no regaço põe fim à maior indignação.

verses.original: שִׂמְחָ֣ה לַ֭צַּדִּיק עֲשׂ֣וֹת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝מְחִתָּ֗ה לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: śim·ḥāh laṣ·ṣad·dîq ‘ă·śō·wṯ miš·pāṭ ū·mə·ḥit·tāh lə·p̄ō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen
verses.literal: Justice executed is a joy to the righteous but a terror to the workers of iniquity
verses.literalPt: O fazer justiça é alegria para o justo, mas destruição para os que praticam a iniqüidade.

verses.original: אָדָ֗ם תּ֭וֹעֶה מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ הַשְׂכֵּ֑ל בִּקְהַ֖ל רְפָאִ֣ים יָנֽוּחַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḏām tō·w·‘eh mid·de·reḵ haś·kêl biq·hal rə·p̄ā·’îm yā·nū·aḥ
verses.literal: The man who strays from the path of understanding will rest in the assembly of the dead
verses.literalPt: O homem que anda desviado do caminho do entendimento, na congregação dos mortos repousará.

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ מַ֭חְסוֹר אֹהֵ֣ב שִׂמְחָ֑ה אֹהֵ֥ב יַֽיִן־ וָ֝שֶׁ֗מֶן לֹ֣א יַעֲשִֽׁיר׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš maḥ·sō·wr ’ō·hêḇ śim·ḥāh ’ō·hêḇ ya·yin- wā·še·men lō ya·‘ă·šîr
verses.literal: He who loves pleasure will become poor . . . the one who loves wine and oil will never be rich
verses.literalPt: O que ama os prazeres padecerá necessidade; o que ama o vinho e o azeite nunca enriquecerá.

verses.original: כֹּ֣פֶר לַצַּדִּ֣יק רָשָׁ֑ע וְתַ֖חַת יְשָׁרִ֣ים בּוֹגֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: kō·p̄er laṣ·ṣad·dîq rā·šā‘ wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ yə·šā·rîm bō·w·ḡêḏ
verses.literal: The wicked become a ransom for the righteous and the faithless for the upright
verses.literalPt: O resgate do justo é o ímpio; o do honrado é o perverso.

verses.original: ט֗וֹב שֶׁ֥בֶת בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ מִדְבָּ֑ר מֵאֵ֖שֶׁת מְדוֹנִים וָכָֽעַס׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ še·ḇeṯ bə·’e·reṣ- miḏ·bār mê·’ê·šeṯ mə·ḏō·nīm wā·ḵā·‘as
verses.literal: Better to live in the desert . . . than with a contentious and ill-tempered wife
verses.literalPt: É melhor morar numa terra deserta do que com a mulher rixosa e irritadiça.

verses.original: אוֹצָ֤ר׀ נֶחְמָ֣ד וָ֭שֶׁמֶן בִּנְוֵ֣ה חָכָ֑ם וּכְסִ֖יל אָדָ֣ם יְבַלְּעֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w·ṣār neḥ·māḏ wā·še·men bin·wêh ḥā·ḵām ū·ḵə·sîl ’ā·ḏām yə·ḇal·lə·‘en·nū
verses.literal: Precious treasures and oil are in the dwelling of the wise but a foolish man consumes them
verses.literalPt: Tesouro desejável e azeite há na casa do sábio, mas o homem insensato os esgota.

verses.original: רֹ֭דֵף צְדָקָ֣ה וָחָ֑סֶד יִמְצָ֥א חַ֝יִּ֗ים צְדָקָ֥ה וְכָבֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: rō·ḏêp̄ ṣə·ḏā·qāh wā·ḥā·seḏ yim·ṣā ḥay·yîm ṣə·ḏā·qāh wə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ
verses.literal: He who pursues righteousness and loving devotion finds life righteousness and honor
verses.literalPt: O que segue a justiça e a beneficência achará a vida, a justiça e a honra.

verses.original: עִ֣יר גִּ֭בֹּרִים עָלָ֣ה חָכָ֑ם וַ֝יֹּ֗רֶד עֹ֣ז מִבְטֶחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘îr gib·bō·rîm ‘ā·lāh ḥā·ḵām way·yō·reḏ ‘ōz miḇ·ṭe·ḥāh
verses.literal: A wise man scales the city of the mighty and pulls down the stronghold in which they trust
verses.literalPt: O sábio escala a cidade do poderoso e derruba a força da sua confiança.

verses.original: שֹׁמֵ֣ר פִּ֭יו וּלְשׁוֹנ֑וֹ שֹׁמֵ֖ר מִצָּר֣וֹת נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: šō·mêr pîw ū·lə·šō·w·nōw šō·mêr miṣ·ṣā·rō·wṯ nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: He who guards his mouth and tongue keeps his soul from distress
verses.literalPt: O que guarda a sua boca e a sua língua guarda a sua alma das angústias.

verses.original: זֵ֣ד יָ֭הִיר לֵ֣ץ שְׁמ֑וֹ ע֝וֹשֶׂ֗ה בְּעֶבְרַ֥ת זָדֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: zêḏ yā·hîr lêṣ šə·mōw ‘ō·w·śeh bə·‘eḇ·raṯ zā·ḏō·wn
verses.literal: Mocker is the name of the proud and arrogant man of him who acts with excessive pride
verses.literalPt: O soberbo e presumido, zombador é o seu nome, trata com indignação e soberba.

verses.original: תַּאֲוַ֣ת עָצֵ֣ל תְּמִיתֶ֑נּוּ כִּֽי־ מֵאֲנ֖וּ יָדָ֣יו לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ta·’ă·waṯ ‘ā·ṣêl tə·mî·ṯen·nū kî- mê·’ă·nū yā·ḏāw la·‘ă·śō·wṯ
verses.literal: The craving of the slacker kills him because his hands refuse to work
verses.literalPt: O desejo do preguiçoso o mata, porque as suas mãos recusam trabalhar.

verses.original: כָּל־ הַ֭יּוֹם הִתְאַוָּ֣ה תַאֲוָ֑ה וְצַדִּ֥יק יִ֝תֵּ֗ן וְלֹ֣א יַחְשֹֽׂךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hay·yō·wm hiṯ·’aw·wāh ṯa·’ă·wāh wə·ṣad·dîq yit·tên wə·lō yaḥ·śōḵ
verses.literal: All day long he covets more but the righteous give without restraint
verses.literalPt: O cobiçoso cobiça o dia todo, mas o justo dá, e nada retém.

verses.original: זֶ֣בַח רְ֭שָׁעִים תּוֹעֵבָ֑ה אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־ בְזִמָּ֥ה יְבִיאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ze·ḇaḥ rə·šā·‘îm tō·w·‘ê·ḇāh ’ap̄ kî- ḇə·zim·māh yə·ḇî·’en·nū
verses.literal: The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable how much more so when brought with ill intent
verses.literalPt: O sacrifício dos ímpios já é abominação; quanto mais oferecendo-o com má intenção!

verses.original: עֵד־ כְּזָבִ֥ים יֹאבֵ֑ד וְאִ֥ישׁ שׁוֹמֵעַ לָנֶ֥צַח יְדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘êḏ- kə·zā·ḇîm yō·ḇêḏ wə·’îš šômēaʿ lā·ne·ṣaḥ yə·ḏab·bêr
verses.literal: A lying witness will perish but the man who listens to truth will speak forever
verses.literalPt: A falsa testemunha perecerá, porém o homem que dá ouvidos falará sempre.

verses.original: הֵעֵ֬ז אִ֣ישׁ רָשָׁ֣ע בְּפָנָ֑יו וְ֝יָשָׁ֗ר ה֤וּא׀ יָכִין דְּרָכָיו׃
verses.transliteration: hê·‘êz ’îš rā·šā‘ bə·p̄ā·nāw wə·yā·šār hū yå̄·ḵīn də·rå̄·ḵå̄w
verses.literal: A wicked man hardens his face but the upright man . . . makes his way sure
verses.literalPt: O homem ímpio endurece o seu rosto; mas o reto considera o seu caminho.

verses.original: אֵ֣ין חָ֭כְמָה וְאֵ֣ין תְּבוּנָ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין עֵ֝צָ֗ה לְנֶ֣גֶד יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ên ḥāḵ·māh wə·’ên tə·ḇū·nāh wə·’ên ‘ê·ṣāh lə·ne·ḡeḏ Yah·weh
verses.literal: There is no wisdom no understanding no counsel that can prevail against the LORD
verses.literalPt: Não há sabedoria, nem inteligência, nem conselho contra o SENHOR.

verses.original: ס֗וּס מ֭וּכָן לְי֣וֹם מִלְחָמָ֑ה וְ֝לַֽיהוָ֗ה הַתְּשׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: sūs mū·ḵān lə·yō·wm mil·ḥā·māh Yah·weh hat·tə·šū·‘āh
verses.literal: A horse is prepared for the day of battle but victory is of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Prepara-se o cavalo para o dia da batalha, porém do SENHOR vem a vitória.
